reasoning: On the season so far the Spurs are the stronger team; with home court the Spurs start about 15 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Spurs win 90 times in 100, by about 16; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.

analyst.text: Utah have lost 11 straight and are badly depleted. Lauri Markkanen is out at least a month with a broken hand, Jaren Jackson Jr. is out with an MCL tear, and Jaxson Hayes hurt his knee in Houston. The young core of Keyonte George, Darryn Peterson and Ace Bailey keeps games competitive, but the losses keep piling up. San Antonio are rolling. The main question is whether they rest banged-up guards De'Aaron Fox and Devin Vassell against a weak opponent. The angle leans towards the Spurs.
